global_rendering_rules: Retain body, salutation, footnote, annotation, scholarly, bibliography and enclosure layers separately; a complete HTML source does not make every layer Darwin-authored.
Preserve MathML and table-like order as source provenance while rendering readable derivatives; never fill missing cells, fractions or words by inference.
A source suffix F, a copied report, or packet context status does not by itself establish fragment extent, receipt, composition date or period eligibility.
Actual figures require separate preservation and human inspection; prose mention of a figure or bibliography entry is not an inspected visual asset.
This candidate contains formatting and chronology requirements only and does not add, accept, or recount relationships.
